svg.text: Não há botão de skill. O movimento é o botão.
A arte não é uma coisa que carregas — é uma coisa que PROVOCAS.
Isso é a diferença entre um bónus passivo e uma competência.
Plant your feet and stop moving.
Reverse hard, back the way you came.
Let them close in around you.
Seis armas em linhas, cinco condições em colunas. Cada arma cobre
as cinco exatamente uma vez — não há buracos, e é por isso que
mudar de arma muda tudo o que fazes sem mudar o que tens de fazer.
Levas 4 das 5 do rolo da arma que tens na mão. Cada uma tem 5
Even in every way. Nothing it does is wrong.
Planted, the arc narrows and runs through what it hits.
At speed, the sweeps come closer together.
Turning leaves an echo of the sweep where you stood.
Surrounded, the sweep finds the gap and cuts twice as deep.
On low health, the sweep throws qi past its own reach.
Heavier and wider. Made for standing in the crowd, not beside
Plant your feet and each kill staunches the wound.
Damage grows the longer you keep moving.
A hard turn carries the blade the whole way round.
The arc widens for every enemy standing close.
On low health, the sweep shoves what it touches away.
Enormous and slow. The gaps between sweeps are where you die.
Planted, the weight goes into the cut.
At speed, the blade comes back through on the same swing.
The sweep after a turn lands like a felled tree.
Surrounded, the blade needs more room and takes it.
On low health, what reaches you lands lighter.
Fast and short. You must stand closer than is comfortable.
Planted, everything goes into a cut you must be close to make.
At speed, the second blade cuts behind you.
A turn throws you forward out of it.
The more of them there are, the faster the hands move.
On low health, the blades leave your hands and circle.
Reaches far and cuts narrow. Where you face matters again.
Planted, the point runs a line through everything ahead.
The faster you go, the further ahead it reaches.
Turning sets the shaft across them and drives them back.
Surrounded, the shaft comes round instead of forward.
On low health, the point spits what it cannot reach.
Almost the full circle, barely past arm’s length.
Planted, the fan opens the whole circle.
At speed, qi comes to you from much further off.
A turn sends the sweep back the way it came.
Surrounded, the blades leave the fan in every direction.
On low health, there is a moment where nothing lands.
O QUE AINDA NÃO É VERDADE
As 30 agem, e escolhes as quatro na aba 法. Mas vão todas ao grau 1
e não sobem: a corrida ainda cresce pelas 3 cartas sorteadas, por
isso a ORDEM em que as puseste ainda não conta. É o passo
